model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1. A blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," begins at 0.18 at layer 0 and decreases to 0.01 at layer 20. An orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," starts at 0.44 at layer 0 and decreases to 0.18 at layer 20, with a visible peak at approximately 0.35 at layer 3 and a minimum of 0.14 at layer 13. A green solid line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," begins at 0.28 at layer 0 and decreases to 0.09 at layer 20, with a minimum of 0.15 at layer 13.
